scenes.text: Describe trade and cooperation with neighbouring countries
Neighbour: a country sharing a land border with another country. Togo: the country along Ghana’s eastern land border.
Côte d’Ivoire: the country along Ghana’s western land border. Burkina Faso: the country along Ghana’s northern land border. Regional trade: buying and selling goods across neighbouring countries.
Label Ghana and its three land neighbours on an outline map.
